segments.text: "I want you to tell me everything you know about the Founder's murder."

Founder of the Shuten Order who was resurrected in a “temporary body”. All memories prior to being murdered were lost. ”Rei Shimobe” is a temporary name to hide their identity as the Founder. Disguised as a detective to find the murderer within the given time limit: dawn, four days from now…
From official website

Rei is actually a hive-mind droid with multiple spare bodies. Her "Power of God" abilities allow her to hack other droids, and her "resurrections" are spare bodies activated upon her death. Five different spare bodies were activated at the same time to investigate each Minister, which Rei mistook as 5 different timelines (routes).
"You can't remember anything? Not even how you died?"

One of the two self-proclaimed “angels,” God’s messengers. Seemingly, their role is to guide Rei...? Impatient and prone to panic, she is the driving force that compels Rei to move forward when reluctant. For some reason, she has clear malice and hatred toward Shuten.
From official website
In truth, she is a spyware program made by humans to hack the Founder and infiltrate Shuten. Her appearance is modeled off the human Himeno from within the Founder's memories.
"Fate has a way of forcing on the worst situations. But it's not all bad..."

One of the two self-proclaimed “angels,” God’s messengers. Seemingly, their role is to guide Rei...? Calm, knowledgeable, and highly analytical, he steadily guides Rei. However, he deflects when asked questions that get to the core of the matter.
From official website
In truth, he is a spyware program made by humans to hack the Founder and infiltrate Shuten. His appearance is modeled off the Founder's human creator, Mikoto, from within her memories.
"Ah, it's times like these where theories really come in handy."

Head of the Ministry of Justice, which administers the law. A free spirit who often says random things and acts spontaneously. He is a knowledgeable and flexible thinker, unrivaled when it comes to resolving disputes. Also known as the “Ghost White Arbitrator." Addicted to legal drugs.
From official website
"Come on... I must have everything be extracted..."

Head of the Ministry of Health, which is in charge of medical care. Also the director of Shuten General Hospital, a medical institution under his control. Known as the “Gatekeeper to the Afterlife” because of his proven medical skills. He appears to be hearty and compassionate, but pathologically meticulous. He loves his younger sister.
From official website
"Sigh... they say 'fools never differ...'"

Head of the Ministry of Science, which controls all aspects of science and technology. Though charmless in both words and action, he is a genius with an unmeasurable IQ, and in charge of designing most of the country's technology. Also known as the “Prodigy”.
From official website
One of the main protagonists of the Ministry of Science route.
"This must be destiny. His death and our meeting!"

Head of the Ministry of Education, which is in charge of education and information. Nicknamed the “Conjurer of Words” for her ability to manipulate information and confuse the public. Many things about her, including her true face, are shrouded in mystery. She's typically quiet, but there are rumors about her ambition to become the next Founder...
From official website
For her "romance game", she dons the disguises of Mii, Kikka, Yua, Shikka, and the entirety of the "Shuten Academy" student body.
"I'm gonna destroy every one of them! I'm gonna wipe them off the face of the earth!"

Head of the Ministry of Security, which maintains public order. Short tempered and aggressive. Particularly hostile to heretics (enemies of the order) and is known as the “Queen of Heretic Hunting”. Wishes for peace in this country more than anyone and tries to protect it.
From official website
"Transfer boy, I love you. Be my boyfriend."

A mysterious girl with unique sensibilities. In addition to her strange way of thinking, she is unable to converse properly with others. The things she says are hard to understand. She communicates through puppets (a boy and a girl).
From official Twitter
She and her "sisters," Mii and Kikka, are alternate personas and disguises for Honoka Kokushikan.
"N-No! I-I can't reciprocate your feelings!"
Tsundere. Intelligent and resolute. Professor-like. Usually cool, but the slightest trigger can make her go wild with erotic fantasies.
[From official Twitter
She and her "sisters," Kikka and Yua, are alternate personas and disguises for Honoka Kokushikan.
"I-It's your fault... for throwing my heart into disarray like this..."
Energetic and friendly. Emotional and gets tensed over the smallest things. Cannot control her emotions. Overreacts to everything and is noisy.
From official Twitter
She and her "sisters," Mii and Yua, are alternate personas and disguises for Honoka Kokushikan.
"Hmph... Hehehe..."
A legendary killer who appears out of nowhere. He wears a tattered costume that was once an amusement park mascot. Cruel and violent. Uses a grotesque jackhammer as a weapon.
From official Twitter

There are two Nephilims. This one is a hallucination caused by the drug "Virus" that induces violence and self-mutilation in victims, emulating the Nephilim murders. The other is Fushicho Kagura, who drugs these victims.
"Perfect! We're going to be rich!"
Yoichi's wife. A celebrity with bad taste who dresses flashily. An unpleasant person who looks down on everyone. Greedy and selfish. She is the greediest person in the Kukuri family.
From official Twitter
Kukuri Estate Head.
Deceased.

Former chairman of Kukuri Pharmaceuticals. He left behind a vast inheritance. There is no doubt about his death, and murder seems unlikely. The will outlining his inheritance is currently held by Kishiru Inugami.
The inheritance conditions written in his will are ominous... There are suspicions he was secretly manufacturing tobacco in the greenhouse and selling it to heretics.

He was worried about his sons getting the inheritance after his death. He appeared to hold a deep appreciation for Mizuno. A hidden lab in the greenhouse basement was used to manufacture "Virus", using tobacco as the base. The refined "Virus" was illicitly sold by Miyabi.

Culprit of the serial murders at the Kukuri estate. Three victims died by traps Kiyomasa had set in advance. The traps were meant to test whether the four inheritance candidates were worthy of inheriting his estate.

In truth, Kiyomasa was being manipulated by Inugami. It was all part of Inugami's scheme to purge the Kukuri family's shady dealings. However, when Kiyomasa, with his worsening illness, used "Virus" on himself, the plan unraveled — or, perhaps it was fate. The Kukuri family, thriving on drug dealing, was already ensnared by Death.
From in-game suspect profile
"But... someone like me..."
Maid for the Kukuri family. A kind-hearted woman. She cared for the head of Kuruki family, Kururi Kiyomasa. Everyone in the Kukuri family takes advantage of her and bullies her.
From official Twitter
"I can't! I can't die here!"

Former leader of a team of kids from the slums. Loyal and caring towards his friends. A spirited delinquent boy. Rides a motorbike. A few years ago, he was arrested and imprisoned for a hit-and-run, but now works at Teko's research lab.
From official Twitter
One of the main protagonists of the Ministry of Science route.
He is a digital copy of the real Ku Otsuki, implanted into the body of Seren Ezaki as a split personality.
"Why are you staring at us, boy?"

The eldest son of the Kukuri family. Also an executive at the company run by the Kukuri family. An unpleasant guy who looks down on everyone but himself. He also disliked his father, Kiyomasa. Arrogant and self-centered.
From official Twitter
"I'm scared, Teko. Scared that you might do something cruel."
A partner robot created by Teko. Though timid, he's quick to make bluffs. His emotions are always fluctuating. Will do anything to protect Teko, but also scolds Teko if he does something wrong.
From official Twitter
"Don't hate me. I was just luckier than you. That's all."
Participant in the death game. Ministry of Health employee. Grows flowers at home. He can't die because he needs to go home and water the flowers.
From official Twitter
"AAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!! ♡"
Participant in the death game. Addicted to love. Emotionally unstable. Likes "landmine-style" fashion and has a dramatic personality.
From official Twitter
"That's not the case… Despite what you might think, I'm a germaphobe."
Manji's favorite bike. Equipped with AI. Polite but rude. Sometimes talks back to Manji, but all things considered, he cares about her.
From official Twitter
A mysterious idol who organized and live-streams the death game.
"Geez... I wish everyone would hurry up and die."
Personal doctor of the Kukuri family. Intelligent, but psychopathically ruthless. He looks down on the stupid and greedy heirs to the Kukuri estate.
From official Twitter
"Happy Times with Animals! Welcome to the Institute for Evolutionary Guidance, Ryugu!"
Image character for the research institute "Ryugu." Positive, high-energy, and good at sales talk. As it is an AI, its age and gender are unknown.
From official Twitter
"With my brain, nothing is impossible!"
Participant in the Death Game. Genius with high IQ, EQ, AQ, and other intelligence quotients. She also has super memory, meaning she never forgets anything she has seen or heard.
From official Twitter
"Just shut up! Don't talk back to me!"
Participant in the Death Game. Ministry of Health employee. A gloomy person who thinks he's no good, but has a rude attitude when speaking. He posts his own novels online.
From official Twitter
"Hehehe... I wonder how many millions I'll be getting..."

Second son of the Kukuri family. An introvert. Stays in his room and devotes himself to trading stocks and online gambling, but ends up in debt. A nasty person who looks down on everyone. Also dislikes his father, Kiyomasa. Sneaky and self-centered.
[From official Twitter
"I can't die here!"
Participant in a death game. Optimistic. Believes in the goodness of others. Too positive, which can be annoying at times. Likes monster mascots.
From official Twitter
"Would you die with me?"

Participant in the Death Game. Ministry of Health employee. A trainee nurse at the hospital. A fan of the Founder who wants to follow the doctrines, and as a result, is not enthusiastic about the Death Game.
From official Twitter
The youngest Fuyuno sister.
Executive.

Takes pride in managing the operations at Kukuri Pharmaceuticals. Pledged loyalty to Kiyomasa and the company during Kiyomasa's lifetime and only cares about the company's future and his own position. Though he has no right to inherit, he believes the inheritance should benefit the company. He looks down on Yoichi and others as spoiled brats, fearing they might take over the company.
From in-game suspect profile
Kukuri Estate Third Son.
Deceased.
His corpse was found on a boat just before the reading of the will began. Could someone have killed him...? He was one of the inheritance candidates.
From in-game suspect profile
Servant.

Loyal to the Kukuri family, virtuous, and selfless. A devoted follower of the Shuten Order. He was hired to handle household tasks and is treated like a workhorse by the family. Naturally, he has no right to inherit. He can't understand at all why there's such tension over the inheritance.
From in-game suspect profile
Participant in the death game.
Participant in the death game.
Participant in the death game. Ministry of Health employee and a nurse at Shuten General Hospital. The fourth oldest Fuyuno sister.
Participant in death game. Ministry of Health employee and the head nurse at Shuten General Hospital. The oldest Fuyuno sister.

An employee at the Ministry of Education and Honoka Kokushikan's subordinate. Under her boss's orders, she dons a disguise and infiltrates Shuten Academy as a student in order to assist Rei Shimobe in the "romance game".
She is actually the secret 4th Kokushikan at the school and one of Honoka's many disguises at the fake Academy.

Manji Fushicho's older twin sister, the previous Minister of Security. Believed to have been killed after becoming a heretic, she is secretly the copycat Nephilim killer, targeting her sister and former employees.
Participant in the Death Game.
Participant in the Death Game.
Participant in the death game. Ministry of Health employee.
Participant in the death game. Ministry of Health employee.
Participant in the death game. Ministry of Health employee.
Participant in the death game.
Participant in the death game.
Participant in the death game.
Participant in the death game.
Yugen Ushitora's terminally ill younger sister. Together they masterminded the Death Game, with Yuko posing as Noa Fukune.
One of the terrorists that attacked Ryugu.
A Special Evolution Tyrannosaurus rex that was created at Ryugu.
The warden at Shuten's prison, The End.
The former deputy director at Ryugu. A prisoner at The End, as well as the CEO of Prison Temp.
She is the mastermind of the heretic attack on Ryugu. She digitally copied the consciousness of Ku Otsuki and implanted it into her right eye.
The human equivalent to Mikotoru, the foremost expert in droid engineering. He created SMB-Type 0 and adopted his niece Himeno.
The human equivalent to Himeru, and Dr. Mikoto's niece, who took her in after her parents' death.
A human assistant to Dr. Mikoto.
A human assistant to Dr. Mikoto.

The Founder and leader of the Shuten Order, a religious nation that wishes for the end of humanity. Beloved by the citizens of Shuten, but only the 5 Ministers have a close relationship with the Founder. Was murdered on National Foundation Day, but the Ministers have hidden the crime from the public.

The Founder was secretly a combat hive-mind droid with multiple spare bodies, created by humans for war. She was hacked by human-made spyware programs, manipulating her memories and personality, creating "Shimobe Rei". Despite this, a conscious part of the Founder's personality survived in Rei's body until she sacrificed herself for Rei.
The first human born following humanity's survival in the Human Ending. Dubbed as the "miracle child", she reminds Shimobe Rei of Himeno.
A human doctor that survived humanity's end and has raised the miracle child.
Ku Otsuki's terminally ill mother, who passed away when Ku was young.
